meta.homeTitle: Bénin AgroMarket — Market prices, finally legible
meta.homeDescription: 2019–2026 price history, seasonal patterns, and 3-month ahead forecasts with uncertainty intervals for white maize, tomato, and white yam (kokoro) across Benin's markets.
meta.explorerDescription: Explore historical price trajectories, monthly seasonal profiles, and spatial price spreads across Benin's well-tracked staple markets.
meta.forecastDescription: 1-, 2-, and 3-month ahead retail price forecasts with 80% and 90% uncertainty intervals and test reliability diagnostics.
meta.methodDescription: Leakage-free evaluation protocol, simple method comparisons, NASA POWER weather analysis, and operational model limits.

forecastPage.title: Market forecasts & honest limits
forecastPage.subtitle: Last 24 observed months followed by 1-, 2-, and 3-month forecasts with 80% and 90% uncertainty intervals and measured test error.
forecastPage.chartSubtitle: Nominal retail prices in XOF/kg (CFA franc). Breaks mark months with no recorded price.
forecastPage.howToReadLine1: 1. The solid line shows observed prices on this market over the past 24 months (with breaks where a month was not recorded).
forecastPage.howToReadLine2: 2. The dashed line extends from October to December 2026: this is the central forecast.
forecastPage.howToReadLine3: 3. Shaded bands show the 80% (inner band) and 90% (outer band) intervals where future prices are expected to fall.
forecastPage.reliabilityHeading: Reliability and method for this horizon

forecastPage.productSkillScopeTemplate: Computed across all {n} well-tracked markets for this commodity.
forecastPage.warningGeneral: These forecasts rely solely on past price records. They cannot foresee sudden shocks (droughts, road disruptions, fuel spikes, or border closures).
forecastPage.warningTomato: Special caution for tomato: this perishable crop experiences sharp month-to-month swings. Measured test errors are noticeably higher than for maize or yam.
